title: Unital tensor shifts compatible with the specified derived pullback
statement: Let $f:Z\to Y$ be a proper morphism of Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-proper-morphism], with their derived categories in one localization universe [def-pc-derived-category], their recorded K-flat derived tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], and $L=Lf^*$ [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Equip $L$ with the supplied strong monoidal structure. There exist coherent integer-shift structures on $L$ and on every functor $-\otimes M$ on both ambient derived categories. For these structures, $L$ and every $-\otimes M$ on $D(\mathcal O_Z)$ preserve distinguished triangles. On both schemes the natural transformation $-\otimes b$ commutes with shifts for every morphism $b:M\to N$. For every $M\in D(\mathcal O_Y)$ the inverse tensorator $L(K\otimes M)\to L(K)\otimes L(M)$, natural in $K$, commutes with the composite shifts. The right-unitor natural transformation $-\otimes\mathcal O_Y\to\mathrm{id}$ commutes with shifts. No direct image, adjunction, projection isomorphism, map to the unit, or specified comparison transformation is part of this statement.

source.place: Proof, exactness of the composite tensor and pullback functors; expanded for the simultaneous unital shifts required by Tags 0A9U and 0A9S (equation-compare-with-pullback).

proof.text: On K-flat representative complexes the Koszul translation comparison for tensor in its first variable is natural in the fixed second factor. It sends the tensor of a cone triangle to the cone triangle of the tensored map. Its zero and addition identities descend through the recorded K-flat tensor localization. This constructs exact shifts on all tensorRight functors on both schemes, with shift compatibility of every tensorRight morphism. The complex right unitor intertwines translation, so its compatibility descends on Y as well.

Compute L by termwise tensor pullback of K-flat resolutions; its representative comparison with translation identifies image mapping-cone triangles. For the supplied monoidal structure, choose this comparison simultaneously with the tensor comparisons, expressing translation as tensor with the translated unit and using the inverse tensorator and unit isomorphism. The tensorator associativity equation supplies addition coherence; its unit equations supply zero coherence and preserve the right-unitor comparison on Y. Moving translation through the inverse tensorator gives its shift equation in the varying first factor. Descend these equations through K-flat localization.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_derivedMonoidalPullback_unitalShift
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] [IsNoetherian Y] (f : Z ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [Functor.Monoidal (derivedPullback f)] :
    ∃ (sL : (derivedPullback f).CommShift ℤ)
      (sY : ∀ M : schemeDerivedCategory Y, (tensorRight M).CommShift ℤ)
      (sZ : ∀ M : schemeDerivedCategory Z, (tensorRight M).CommShift ℤ),
      letI := sL
      letI := sY
      letI := sZ
      (derivedPullback f).IsTriangulated ∧
      (∀ M : schemeDerivedCategory Z, (tensorRight M).IsTriangulated) ∧
      (∀ {M N : schemeDerivedCategory Y} (b : M ⟶ N),
        NatTrans.CommShift ((curriedTensor (schemeDerivedCategory Y)).flip.map b) ℤ) ∧
      (∀ {M N : schemeDerivedCategory Z} (b : M ⟶ N),
        NatTrans.CommShift ((curriedTensor (schemeDerivedCategory Z)).flip.map b) ℤ) ∧
      (∀ M : schemeDerivedCategory Y,
        NatTrans.CommShift (F₁ := tensorRight M ⋙ derivedPullback f)
          (F₂ := derivedPullback f ⋙ tensorRight ((derivedPullback f).obj M))
          ((Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δNatTrans (derivedPullback f)).flipApp M) ℤ) ∧
      NatTrans.CommShift (rightUnitorNatIso (schemeDerivedCategory Y)).hom ℤ
